description: This file defines an abstract class 'RtNotifier' which declares several pure virtual callback methods related to Xcast application and service events.

classes.name: RtNotifier
classes.description: An abstract class providing a set of callback methods for handling various Xcast application and service events.

methods.name: onRtServiceDisconnected
methods.description: Callback invoked when the RT service disconnects.

methods.name: onXcastApplicationLaunchRequest
methods.description: Callback invoked when there is a request to launch an Xcast application, providing application name and parameters.

methods.name: onXcastApplicationStopRequest
methods.description: Callback invoked when there is a request to stop an Xcast application, providing application name and ID.

methods.name: onXcastApplicationHideRequest
methods.description: Callback invoked when there is a request to hide an Xcast application, providing application name and ID.

methods.name: onXcastApplicationResumeRequest
methods.description: Callback invoked when there is a request to resume an Xcast application, providing application name and ID.

methods.name: onXcastApplicationStateRequest
methods.description: Callback invoked when there is a request to retrieve the state of an Xcast application, providing application name and ID.
